title: Heisenberg–Weil equivalence Cosh_G(X,phi) ≃ Cosh_G(X,1_{QJ})
body_html:
Heisenberg–Weil-style equivalence on cosheaves

Hypotheses:

  • $J$ is a cosheaf of subgroups of $G$ on $X$ with $J_E \trianglelefteq \Fix_G(E)$ and pro-order invertible in $R$;
  • $Q$ is a sheaf of subgroups with $Q_E \trianglelefteq \Fix_G(E)$ and $Q_E \cap J_E$ normalized by $J_E$;
  • $\phi$ is a sheaf of characters of $Q$;
  • $\check{\mathscr{K}} \in \Cosh_G(X, R, \phi^{-1})$ with $\check{\mathscr{K}}_E|_{J_E} \cong \eta_E^*$, where $\eta_E$ is the unique irreducible $J_E$-type with $\eta_E|_{Q_E \cap J_E}$ being $\phi_E|_{Q_E \cap J_E}$-isotypic;
  • compatibility $\eta_E \cong \cInd_{J_F(Q_E \cap J_E)}^{J_E}(\eta_F \otimes \phi_E|_{Q_F \cap J_E})$ for $E \preceq F$;
  • the torsor $\mathfrak{I}_{\mathrm{Fix}, J}(\check{\mathscr{K}})$ is non-empty, containing an object $\mathscr{K}$ with $(\check{\mathscr{K}} \otimes \mathscr{K})_J$ trivial.

Define functors $$\mathfrak{R} : \Cosh_G(X, R, \phi) \to \Cosh_G(X, \mathbf 1_{QJ}), \qquad \mathfrak{R}^\mathscr{V}_E := (\check{\mathscr{K}}_E \otimes \mathscr{V}_E)_{J_E},$$ $$\mathfrak{S} : \Cosh_G(X, \mathbf 1_{QJ}) \to \Cosh_G(X, R, \phi), \qquad \mathfrak{S}^\mathscr{W} := \mathscr{W} \otimes \mathscr{K}.$$

Proposition. $\mathfrak{R}$ and $\mathfrak{S}$ are quasi-inverse equivalences: $$\Cosh_G(X, R, \phi) \;\simeq\; \Cosh_G(X, \mathbf 1_{QJ}).$$
proof_html:
For $\mathscr{W} \in \Cosh_G(X, \mathbf 1_{QJ})$: $$\mathfrak{R}^{\mathfrak{S}^\mathscr{W}} = (\check{\mathscr{K}} \otimes (\mathscr{W} \otimes \mathscr{K}))_J \cong \mathscr{W} \otimes (\check{\mathscr{K}} \otimes \mathscr{K})_J \xrightarrow{\epsilon} \mathscr{W}.$$

For $\mathscr{V} \in \Cosh_G(X, R, \phi)$, build the map $$\gamma'_E : \mathscr{K}_E \otimes \check{\mathscr{K}}_E \otimes \mathscr{V}_E \to \mathscr{V}_E, \quad a \otimes b \otimes v \mapsto \int_{J_E} \epsilon_E(a \otimes j \cdot b)\, j \cdot v \, dj,$$ which descends to an iso $\gamma_E : (\mathscr{K} \otimes (\check{\mathscr{K}} \otimes \mathscr{V})_J)_E \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathscr{V}_E$ since $\mathscr{V}_E$ is $\eta_E$-isotypic. The $\gamma_E$ are $G$-equivariant and compatible with restrictions (using $\epsilon_F(a \otimes j \cdot b) \ne 0$ only for $j \in J_F H_E$, $H_E := J_E \cap Q_E$). $\square$

Where used

In §8, this is the abstract source of the Res/Sat equivalence between $\Coeff_G(\BSigma, \Phi)$ and $\Coeff_M^0(\mathcal{B}(M))$.
